entry: INSDC L09137.2, Cloning vector pUC19c, complete sequence (2,686 bp, circular)
attribution: INSDC (ENA, NCBI) L09137.2; Yanisch-Perron C, Vieira J, Messing J. Gene 33:103-119 (1985)
trimmed: the FASTA record’s letters only, converted to the seq format because FASTA has no cyclic flag: one cyclic system named pUC19c (the record has no feature annotation but source)

entry: the rotated variant’s letters: the record turned to an origin at 2000, inside bla
derived: the record’s letters from position 2000, then those before it, computed in code from the record’s letters (src/plasmid/derive.ts)

entry: the features and sites of the rotated variant (origin at 2000, inside bla), a generated primer site across it
derived: bla and lacZα as open reading frames, the cloning site from EcoRI to HindIII, the origin by its signature, every site of the listed enzymes, all turned to the new origin; the primer site is generated, computed in code from the record’s letters (src/plasmid/derive.ts)

entry: the rotated variant as a GenBank flat file: its letters and the GFF3’s features (bla across the origin a join, lacZα a complement), no sites
derived: the rotated letters and the features of the GFF3 written as an NCBI-shaped record (LOCUS, DEFINITION, SOURCE, a REFERENCE, a COMMENT, FEATURES with /label and /translation, ORIGIN), computed in code from the record’s letters (src/plasmid/derive.ts)
